narrative: Implemented missing helper functions to programmatically generate TTF and MLF datasets. This resolves the import errors encountered during discovery workflows and allows autonomous generation of prerequisite data.
purpose: Ensure jtc can call ttfcli and mlfcli routines directly so the DISCOVERY workflow completes without manual intervention.
future_scene: Before: running discovery target generation failed due to missing 'generate_ttf_for_pattern' import. Now: other modules can invoke these helpers seamlessly, enabling full dataset creation for ML analysis.
